title: Fix and complete user feedback handling (caller-scoped retrieval)

requirements.text: Add a backend query endpoint to retrieve only the signed-in caller’s feedback entries (caller-scoped feedback list) so non-admin users can view their own submitted feedback without requiring admin access.

quotes: add support for handling user feedback

acceptanceCriteria: Backend exposes a query method (e.g., getCallerFeedback) that returns only FeedbackEntry records where entry.user == caller.
The method enforces the same authenticated user permission check used elsewhere (non-authenticated callers are rejected).
The existing admin-only getAllFeedback behavior remains unchanged (still restricted to admins).

requirements.text: Update the frontend feedback data hook to call the new caller-scoped backend feedback endpoint instead of calling the admin-only getAllFeedback, so the Feedback page works for regular authenticated users.

quotes: add support for handling user feedback

acceptanceCriteria: frontend/src/hooks/useFeedback.ts uses the caller-scoped backend method (e.g., actor.getCallerFeedback()) for the ['feedback','caller'] query.
A signed-in non-admin user can load /feedback and see their previous feedback entries (if any) without receiving an authorization error.
Submitting feedback still works and the list updates after submission via React Query invalidation.
No changes are made to any files under frontend/src/components/ui or other immutable paths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.

constraints: Backend must remain a single-actor Motoko canister; all logic stays in backend/main.mo.

Do not edit immutable frontend paths: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, and anything under frontend/src/components/ui.
Use English for any user-facing text.
nonGoals: Building an admin UI for reviewing all users’ feedback.
Adding third-party integrations (email, chat, ticketing, analytics) for feedback handling.
Changing the visual theme or adding new branding assets.
